reason: 该插件的核心用途是监控与展示 LLM API 用量：在 DSH 主机端监听 API 调用并汇总实时/分对话统计，同时在设置页提供展示与历史扫描入口。证据来自仓库 README 对流事件监听、按会话聚合、扫描会话日志历史以及 `/status` 与 `/history` 接口的说明，及 package.json 对 web 插件能力的声明。

summaries.zh: 这个插件用于在 DSH 设置页显示当前与分对话的 LLM API 用量，并支持按需扫描历史会话日志查看历史用量。
summaries.en: This plugin displays current and per-conversation LLM API usage in the DSH settings page and supports on-demand scanning of historical conversation logs.

capabilities: Observes LLM API call events to collect provider/model usage metrics in the host process.
Aggregates token usage and call counts in memory for current runtime and per-session views.
Exposes local HTTP endpoints for current status and historical usage queries.
Renders usage metrics in a settings-page UI with periodic polling and manual history refresh.

reasons.code: README documents interception of `llm/stream` calls and tracking of provider/model/token usage for API usage monitoring.
README documents host-side routes `/api/dsh-api-usage-monitor/status` and `/api/dsh-api-usage-monitor/history` plus a client page that polls for status and reads history.
Package metadata defines a DSH bundle with web client surface, indicating integrated host/web plugin behavior.
Repository summary and tree show dedicated host and client entry files (`lib/index.js`, `lib/client.js`) for event aggregation and settings-page display.
